researchNotes: Range list from the official site's Shopify products.json feed (EDP, Extrait and Essence products only; attars, body care, gift sets and samples skipped). Notes, family, concentration and perfumer read from each official product page. Man/Woman versions are separate entries as the site lists them. Several pages show both a notes-and-ingredients list and a separate perfume-notes list that disagree slightly (e.g. Overture Woman, Portrayal Woman); where unclear the first list was used, and Portrayal Woman notes were left empty. Release years and accords not stated on pages, so left null/[]. Family is the page's olfactive family label. Perfumer names as extracted from page text.

fragrances.name: Boundless

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Boundless by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes review: wear time 'all day', sillage 'Amouage standard (read: insane)', best in cooler months.

fragrances.name: Interlude 53 Man
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento product page (search result text): very long-lasting, projection described as enormous, recommended for winter and night; Scento sillage/longevity wording used. Sillage set 4 (Scento enormous vs a retailer note of strong); reviews of the 2012 Interlude Man not used.

fragrances.name: Elsewhere

sources.name: Brotherhood of Scent — SOTD: Elsewhere by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Brotherhood of Scent SOTD: projection 'roaringly large', sillage 'phenomenal', room-filler; no drop-off after 6 hours (total duration not stated).

fragrances.name: Reflection 45 Man

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Reflection 45 Man Extrait de Parfum Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual review: 45% perfume-oil extrait that lasted 12 hours on the reviewer's skin; no sillage figure given.

fragrances.name: Sunshine Woman
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Jadof review: 8-10 hours (to 12 on oily skin), strong for 2h then moderate, close to skin later; Basenotes reviewer: moderate sillage, good projection, about 7 hours.

fragrances.name: Love Hibiscus

sources.name: Leave No Cologne Unturned — Amouage Love Hibiscus review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Leave No Cologne Unturned review: lasted a good 8-10 hours before turning into a skin scent; no sillage figure given.

fragrances.name: Sequence
fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragranceOfficial review: about 5 hours of continuous projection, 'massive aura', lasts over a day on fabric; skin longevity not given in hours.

fragrances.name: Honour Woman

sources.name: Scento — Amouage Honour Woman (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento aggregated user reviews: long-lasting wear with moderate projection; Lucky Scent reviewer says the sillage is mild but wear time holds up; Parfumo users rate sillage 5-7/10. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. Honour 43 Woman (extrait) not used.

fragrances.name: Opus VII Reckless Leather

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Opus VII Reckless Leather EDP Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual review: eight hours of wear with 'immense projection' (20% oil concentration).

fragrances.name: Opus XVI Timber

sources.name: Half White Boy — Opus XVI Timber by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Blog review: starts strong, then stays in moderate projection for most of a 'long life'; no hours given.

fragrances.name: Outlands
fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragrance: about 4 h clearly detectable on skin, sillage within arm's length, 48 h on fabric; ScentAdvice: still smelled it almost 20 h in. Sources differ.

fragrances.name: Lustre
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumista.vn review (Vietnamese): fairly strong trail for the first 3 h then moderate, about 9 h on skin; suited to cold weather.

fragrances.name: Gold Woman

sources.name: Now Smell This — Amouage Gold Woman review (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Now Smell This review (search text): powerful sillage for about an hour, then moderate and diffuse; Libertine reviewer calls longevity epic. One Parfumo reviewer finds sillage and longevity weak. Retailer (over 12 h) and dupe-seller (13-14 h) figures are promotional and were not used for the level. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 4 early, softening later.

fragrances.name: Gold Man

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Gold Man by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: 'considerable sillage and staying power', 'super projection and sillage'; one reviewer notes about five hours of longevity, others say it lasts very long; hours not consistent.

fragrances.name: Lilac Love
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: initially strong sillage but moderate projection; skin scent from about hour 6, detectable for 15.75 h in total.

fragrances.name: Ashore

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Ashore Eau de Parfum Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Varanis Ridari blog: wear time about 8 h, moderate sillage, a summer scent; Escentual: well beyond 5-6 h, faint trace by evening after a mid-morning spray.

fragrances.name: Lyric Woman

sources.name: Bois de Jasmin — Amouage Lyric Woman

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: 12.75 h in total but only about 4.5 h with noticeable projection; Bois de Jasmin: skin-scent level within 15 minutes, very gentle sillage.

fragrances.name: Jubilation 40 Man
fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragrance: great longevity, very good sillage but does not project like a bomb; Ali Perfumewala: lasts long but stays close to skin, projection 5/10; no hours given.

fragrances.name: Lineage

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Lineage Eau de Parfum Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual review: lasts eight hours on skin; no sillage figure.

fragrances.name: Guidance
fragrances.performanceEvidence: House of Monac review: typically 10-14 h on skin, strong projection in the first hours, notable sillage, still on clothes next day.

fragrances.name: Crimson Rocks
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: about 13.75 h in total, big sillage early that softens, generally soft projection; ScentVerdict: about 6-10 h, fills a room, best autumn/winter.

fragrances.name: Meander
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: just under 14 h in total, skin scent from about hour 8, low sillage; another blog says sillage strong past 10 h, so sillage left blank.

fragrances.name: Journey Woman

sources.name: The Scentaur — Journey Woman EDP review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scentaur: 6-8 h at decent volume, intimate projection; Kafkaesque: 12.75-14.5 h in total, light and airy, skin scent from about hour 4.5.

fragrances.name: Journey Man
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: lasted roughly 13.75 h, sillage moderate on average, close to the skin from the 6th hour.

fragrances.name: Jubilation XXV Man

sources.name: Venba — Amouage Jubilation XXV Man EDP (search result text)
Parfumo — Jubilation 25 for Men reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Mixed: Venba retailer text says 10-14 h and strong sillage (level 5 / 4); Parfumo review snippets are split, with longevity good to excellent but sillage moderate and fading after the first hours. Most common view used: longevity 4, sillage 3; no seasons stated.

fragrances.name: Memoir Woman

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Memoir Woman by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: 13 h on skin, moderate sillage, excellent projection; 'great winter, evening fragrance'; cool spring and autumn evenings.

fragrances.name: Memoir Man

sources.name: Parfumo — Amouage Memoir Man (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reports range from about 5 h (Parfumo) to 8-12 h (retailer and fragrance site listings); most descriptions call sillage moderate, one reviewer strong. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. Reformulation remark noted but not used.

fragrances.name: Jubilation 25 Woman
fragrances.performanceEvidence: NST: a spritz lasts a good eight hours; Kafkaesque: heavy sillage for 2 h, close to skin by hour 3, about 5 h total on him. Sources differ.

fragrances.name: Dia Man

sources.name: Parfumo — Amouage Dia for Men reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo reviewers: lasts well, 6-8 h typical in one report, one claims about 14 h and one about 6 h at most; most describe modest, intimate projection, one scores sillage 2.5/10. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 2.

fragrances.name: Interlude Man

sources.name: Sam Talks Style — Amouage Interlude Man review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: 14.75 h with 4 big sprays, good sillage for about 3 h; Sam Talks Style: lasts a good 24 h on skin and you will be present in the room.

fragrances.name: Epic Man

sources.name: Scento — Amouage Epic Man (search result text)
Parfumo — Amouage Epic Man reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento aggregated user data: long-lasting with strong projection; Parfumo reviews range from over 12 h to a few sprays lasting all day, one reviewer says 6 h; sillage described as moderate to strong and moderate by some. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. No season or time stated.

fragrances.name: Reflection Man
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: lasts 7-10 hours, moderate to strong for the first 2-3 hours then moderate; a Parfumo-based search summary calls longevity/sillage strong but one reviewer finds it fades quickly, so views vary. Seasons not used: Vivir's seasonal ratings were inconsistent between retrievals.

fragrances.name: Opus XIV Royal Tobacco

sources.name: Ali Perfumewala — Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Ali Perfumewala: still evolving past 12 h, 1-2 sprays enough, 'remarkably powerful'; a winter and autumn fragrance.

fragrances.name: Opus V Woods Symphony

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Opus V Woods Symphony EDP Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual review: lasts around eight hours (20% oil concentration); described as light.

fragrances.name: Opus XIII Silver Oud

sources.name: iFragrance — Amouage Opus XIII Silver Oud Review
Basenotes — Opus XIII Silver Oud by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragrance: 10-12 h on skin, heavy projection for about 3 h then a soft cloud, trail for roughly 10 h; Basenotes reviewers: exceptional longevity, still present next morning.

fragrances.name: Epic 56 Woman

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Epic 56 Woman Extrait Review
Basenotes — Positive Reviews of Epic 56 Woman

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual: lasted a strong twelve hours on skin from one spritz; Basenotes reviewer: still going strong more than 14 h in.

fragrances.name: Honour 43 Woman

sources.name: Escentual — Amouage Honour 43 Woman Extrait Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Escentual: lasted an amazing ten to twelve hours on the reviewer's skin; no sillage figure.

fragrances.name: Overture Man

sources.name: Parfumo — Amouage Overture Man (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo reviewers: about 8-10 h typical, one over 12 h, and Parfumo projection and longevity above average; reviewers describe sillage as strong and room-filling, with some saying moderate. Several reviewers suggest cooler weather and evenings. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 4.

fragrances.name: Interlude Black Iris Man

sources.name: Vivir — Amouage Interlude Black Iris Man
Basenotes — Reviews of Interlude Black Iris Man

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir: 10+ h, heavy projection for the first 3-4 h, strong sillage; Basenotes reviewer: enormous performer, 24+ h if allowed.

fragrances.name: Beach Hut Man

sources.name: iFragrance — Amouage Beach Hut Man Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragrance review: among the strongest-performing summer fragrances, longevity, sillage and projection all strong, compliments still 24 h after application.

fragrances.name: Honour Man

sources.name: Beautinow — Amouage Honour Man EDP (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow listing (search text): 8-10 h with moderate sillage; Perfumenez: 8-12 h on most skin; one Parfumo reviewer found longevity and projection modest. A Vivir EDP article claims 12-16 h but its scores look inconsistent and were not used for the level. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3.

fragrances.name: Epic Woman

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Epic Woman by Amouage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque: about 13.5 h, moderate then soft sillage; Basenotes reviewers: 14 h, moderate sillage, 'good wintery scent', too much in summer heat.

fragrances.name: Reflection Woman

sources.name: Parfumo — Amouage Reflection Woman (search result text only, page not opened)
Beautinow — Amouage Reflection Woman EDP (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo community averages about 7.2/10 for longevity and a lower sillage score (about 6/10 in one review); a retailer listing gives 8-10 h and describes a moderate trail. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. Scento sillage wording (strong) conflicts and was not used for the level.

fragrances.name: Beloved
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Cafleurebon calls longevity outstanding and sillage average; Parfumo reviewers (via search result) report about 10 to 14 hours and sillage from light-to-medium to good. Women's Beloved; the separate Beloved Man edition was not covered.

sources.name: Parfumo — Amouage Beloved review (search result only, page not opened)

fragrances.name: Beloved Man

sources.name: Product description supplied by the app owner
Varanis Ridari — Beloved Man by Amouage (2013)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Varanis Ridari: long wear time, projection and sillage good but not atomic; best in fall or winter.
